title: Mixed Event — Raise Your Bow in a Snow-White World — Episode1 That Face I Once Saw

meta.Event: Raise Your Bow in a Snow-White World
meta.Episode: Episode1 — That Face I Once Saw
meta.Event Outline: One day at the archery club, by a strange coincidence, Shizuku senses something hidden beneath Mafuyu's smile. It reminds her of the time when they met for the first time and...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Just ten more seconds.
Keep going, everyone! You can do it!

rows.Speaker: First-Year Archery Club Member A
rows.Line:
Hnng...! Fifty-five, fifty-six, fifty-seven...!
Planking's so hard!

rows.Speaker: First-Year Archery Club Member A
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I thought I was done for!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Everyone, that was very impressive.
You've all grown so much since you first joined this club, and this is proof of that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know it's not for a while, but I believe you'll all do wonderfully during our next tournament. So, please keep up the good work.

rows.Speaker: First-Year Archery Club Members A & B
Shizuku
rows.Line: Now that we're finished doing strength drills, let's get the targets ready...

rows.Speaker: First-Year Archery Club Member A
rows.Line:
Oh, we'll put them up!
Please take a break, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: First-Year Archery Club Member A
rows.Line: This is so great! Hinomori praised us!

rows.Speaker: First-Year Archery Club Member B
rows.Line: And she seemed totally fine while planking just now! I guess idols need to keep their cool like that, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you for running strength drills with the first years today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I noticed that they were beginning to lose their focus a little after competing in the newcomer tournament, so I appreciate you stopping by today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I didn't do anything special, really.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I mean, I haven't been able to show up for practice much lately because of MORE MORE JUMP! activities...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I'll head over now.
Good luck with practicing for the individuals match, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Members
rows.Line: Thank you very much! If you'll excuse us!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There was no one left in the changing room.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay. Then, let's start closing up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, it's my turn today, so I'll return the key to the teachers.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you, but I'll go with you...
There's something I need to ask them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You will?
Hehe. Then, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The first years have become much better archers since I last saw them.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I believe the newcomer tournament played a big role.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I suppose it's only natural to take official matches more seriously.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (When I was a first year, I received quite a lot of advice from others around this time of year, which helped me have more confidence in myself...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (So much was going on back then...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Look, they're all in the studying room together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
They all seem to be working very hard...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: They've all retired from club activities and have entrance exams coming up. And when I go down the third years' corridor, there's a sort of tension in the air.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: When we become third years, the time will also come for us to retire and study...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right...
I know it's inevitable, but that time will eventually come...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I feel a little sad about that actually.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Me too. Especially since we've been doing this since we were first years.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, we have our futures to think about, and that's going to be our time to decide what we want to do in life...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Asahina, speaking of which...
You're trying to get into medical school, yes?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. The first years told me.
Some of them saw you buying study guides for it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see.
I feel a little embarrassed now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, don't.
You'd make a wonderful doctor since you're such a kind person.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, please do your best, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I need to do my best.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
It looked like you were thinking about something else just now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I must've been thinking about entrance exams again and how much I have to study for them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But she seemed different compared to normal for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That reminds me, Hinomori. When you were a first year, you decided to join the archery club as a way to improve your posture, yes?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Huh? Yes, that's right...
I vaguely remember mentioning that when we first visited the club.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, and it left an impression on me because your posture was already very good. I suppose I should expect no less from an idol.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, it's just...
I was still trying to get started as an idol back then.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Oh, what are you two still doing here? It's time to head home for the day.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, hello.
We were just about to return the key to the archery range...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Ah, I was just about to head back. Why don't I deliver that for you?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
You will?
Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Shii, it's you...
I'm sorry. You startled me a little. Is there something you need...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You seemed more than a little startled. Well, anyway... I came to let you know that it's your turn to take a bath.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But there's something on my mind right now, so I think I'll wait until later to take a bath.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, but I appreciate your concern.
Something is bothering me a little is all.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, but I'm not sure how to put it into words...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I'd like some time to think on it more.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
To get a better idea...
Okay, I understand.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In that case, I'll let Mom know that she can go before you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you, Shii!
I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's just like what I saw that other time...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She seemed to have something on her mind that time as well.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Does that mean there's something bothering her...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I could be jumping to the wrong conclusion...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hm? I thought I heard someone calling my...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Good evening!
Sorry, we know it's late!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
KAITO? Miku?
It's awfully late for you to be visiting me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <We came here hoping that we could ask you for some advice, Shizuku.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes! We were thinking about altering some of our costumes for our next show.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <They're ones that have been sitting in the dressing room and we want to change things up a little.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Remember how you all came up with your own costume designs? We decided to think up ideas for alterations in the same way...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Yes, me too.
I've also been having trouble coming up with ideas.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So, Shizuku, since you're really good at coming up with design ideas, we thought we should ask you.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
I'm not as good as you say I am, but I'll be more than happy to help.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <If possible, we'd like to have something warm that goes with the season...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Something warm...
In that case, why not try using a fluffy material that insulates well for the sleeves?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, something that looks like ice crystals. Not only will they look pretty, they'll give your costumes a nice, wintery feel.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You could even have imitation snow fall from above to go along with your costumes.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry!
Our conversation reminded me of something else...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Something else?
Oh, is there something bothering you...?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It has a bit to do with something I remembered about my friend from club...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But it's more of a personal matter...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <If talking to someone else about it will make you feel better, I'll be more than happy to listen.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: KAITO... Hehe. Thank you very much.
